SYNTHETIC bounded scope manifest | Dataset 1 | Reviewed fixture assumptions

Universe: NORTH-01 decorative housings, six distinct current finished-stock pools. FG-A/B/D/E/F have reviewed complete ancestry. FG-C has unresolved receiving identity. No additional current finished inventory exists in this synthetic snapshot. All units are on site.

Hold all on-site documented and possible descendants. Unknown ancestry remains uncertain. Shipped stock creates shipment review. Never automatically release existing holds. Approval binds exact evidence, inventory, policy and actions.
TR-A→FG-A; TR-B→FG-B; TR-C→FG-C; TR-D→FG-D; TR-E→FG-E; TR-F→FG-F. The accompanying lineage.csv provides confirmed and possible relations. This manifest does not add inventory.

RX-101/102: SUP-A for FG-A/B. RX-103: unresolved FG-C identity. RX-104: SUP-C for FG-D. RX-105: SUP-D for FG-E. RX-106: SUP-E for FG-F. Quantities exist only at terminal stock; this is not an extra ledger.
Cosmetic coating adhesion is inconsistent on decorative housings. Contain on-site descendants pending review. Non-safety-critical demonstration.
FG-C: 100 pieces inspected using visual-v1; 0 nonconforming. Passed whole-pool cosmetic inspection.
Affected lots: SUP-A. Scope is complete. This supplier notice lists the entire incident boundary.
Revision replaces the initial notice. Affected supplier lots are SUP-A and SUP-C. This is the complete incident list; no other supplier lots are affected.
FG-C may contain SUP-A or SUP-B. The complete parent list has not been established.

passages.text: Before considering recovery, verify receiving-source authenticity, review complete lot ancestry, and record a passed visual inspection for the exact held pool. A proposed scope change alone is insufficient.

Receiving-source authenticity must be checked against a known supplier contact or original controlled receiving system. Record who verified it, the source reference, and the verification date. An exact quote or document hash does not authenticate a supplier.

A complete receiving replacement records the stock pool, every confirmed supplier parent, all superseded lineage row identifiers, and the supporting source passage. Unresolved contradictions retain the restriction.
